causalAutopsy.notes: The eligibility signal was extended once before for exactly this class of incident (an open llm-circuit, after a session died on arrival on the Mini in June). Inability to START a session was never enumerated as a cause, and it is the one cause that makes a machine look BEST rather than worst: no load, no sessions, untouched quota. Latent since placement began scoring on load.

classClosure.reason: The tracker takes no action: it is a counter read by the existing capacity heartbeat. The only action is one attention item per episode, guarded by the state transition and deduped on a fixed id.
